title: Consent log
intro: Every outbound attempt, why it was allowed, and what came of it. Written before the call goes out, never edited afterwards, kept on this machine.
basis_in_person: Consent on file, signed in person
empty_title: Nothing has been called out yet
empty_body: The log fills itself the moment a campaign starts dialling. Inbound calls are not recorded here — they have their own archive.
dnc_body: Anyone who says stop, or writes STOP on any channel, lands here in the same second. No campaign can call these numbers, and an entry cannot be deleted — only annotated.
dnc_by_hand: Added by Sabine, request in writing
retention_note: The log outlives the recordings on purpose: proof that a call was allowed has to survive longer than the call itself.
error_title: A signature in the chain does not match
error_body: Each entry is signed with the one before it, so a single altered row breaks the chain from that point on. Entries up to 14 August verify. Everything after has to be checked against the nightly backup before this log counts as evidence.
